text_block_list.text: —An unexpected feat was accomplished.

Looking back on Seeking the Pearl's 
journey along the Classic road...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let us pursue the mile route rather than 
the Oaks. The mile is truly where I am at 
my best!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm crossing the Shuka Sho off our goals. 
The path leading from there to the world 
no longer exists!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...That is what I said, wasn't it, 
Trainer? I'm quite sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even so... are you a devil?! Or maybe a 
demon?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running the entire Triple Tiara... I guess 
I ended up getting a little carried away, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you won them all! See, you 
can do it when you try!

I miraculously managed to achieve it. Of 
course, it was also because we trained 
aiming specifically for that.

Seeking the Pearl brilliantly claimed the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It's time for a celebration 
party! Assemble, my classmates!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Say what you will, Pearl-san 
is seriously strong. She totally beat me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~. Though we were running the 
Classic Triple Crown, so we couldn't join 
you~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Well, I'm the type who's 
better suited for long, winding approach 
paths, much like the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really all right for me to be 
here? Even though I hardly left any mark 
on the turf, to receive an invitation...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course, no problem at all. Now that the 
Classic Road is behind us, the battle 
among our generation is at an end.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us share our memories of the 
youth we sprinted through!

Mejiro Dober, Mejiro Bright, 
Matikanefukukitaru, Silence Suzuka. These 
were the Umamusume who ran through the 
Classic period together.

"The party with everyone was a huge 
success, and after the feast ended—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san? What are you doing out here all 
alone?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful... It's truly magnificent, 
absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, what's so amazing? Winning the 
Triple Tiara?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. What's truly amazing 
is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a world where anyone can aim for 
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's only natural for any Umamusume to 
aim for the Triple Tiara, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course. ...A bat.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it exists somewhere? A 
world where even that is not permitted.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Some can't even participate depending on 
where they were born and raised. Divided 
before they can even run..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel like such a world and era might 
actually exist out there somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san says such strange things. 
Although...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if such a world or era existed, 
wouldn't it be fine to change it little by 
little?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
True. But if our revolution... our change 
doesn't make it in time...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, I might never have been able to 
compete with you for the Triple Tiara like 
this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: There's that possibility too... Then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It really was a blessing, wasn't it? For 
us to be born into this world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so give them the greatest bless—the 
greatest blessing! Even more than for me 
achieving the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To a world where all our peers can laugh 
and compete together like this.
